features: Themed Maps workspace and shared-header folder action
Current-location permission flow, GPS/network/last-fix and manual fallback
Offline US ZIP/ZIP+4, cities/coordinates and Photon online place/address search
Viewport-only cached OSM tiles, pan/pinch, accessible controls and dropped pins
Named bookmarks and saved route snapshots, rename/delete and recovery
Drive/walk/cycle routes with geometry, metrics and instruction list
Units/radius/cache controls, Help and visible source credits

validation.visual_review: Themed native direction/map screenshots inspected. Map screen uses one explicitly injected real OSM fixture tile, not full live network coverage. No screenshots included in source deliverable.
validation.ui: Folder/bookmarks, rename, saved directions rename/reopen, ZIP search, actual raster drawing, new-place centering clears stale route, and revocation hide passed

public_https_checks.scope: Public Nashville samples via build environment HTTPS; not Android native-client or phone qualification

validation.apk: Included in user-requested OnKlav0.95.0-maps1/code103 ARM64 debug APK; original signer, source-matched native/20included apps, ZIP integrity and16KiB alignment verified
validation.phone_acceptance: not performed; live GPS/provider permissions, native Android TLS/cache, touch/rotation, accessibility and sustained performance remain separate

test_notes: Initial Kotlin property/method setter clash fixed before successful compilation
Initial inverse projection wrapped longitude incorrectly; corrected and roundtrip/dateline checks passed
Modal text selectors were narrowed to editable controls to avoid duplicate bookmark text
Visual review found route fit overriding new search centering and missing standalone Surface; corrected, then UI regression asserted exact new-place coordinates and empty stale route
Roundabout entry/exit instructions do not invent a missing exit number; new cases passed
Generated unit-test cache cleared after transient Gradle binary-store error; final provider/UI and full lint succeeded
Passing backend cases retained across bounded selections; repeat runs add no unique checks

limits.routing: Route preview/instructions, without voice navigation, traffic or auto-rerouting
limits.offline: Saved places and route snapshots; cached viewport tiles may be available; no offline-area/bulk tile download
limits.providers: Best-effort public services; fixed signed origins, no auto fallback to public Nominatim/OSRM demo/Overpass
